texts.label: English translation
texts.content: Jeremy, I saw a glyph that we are actually on the record. So I'm on the side of the... in French it's Rivière Richelieu. So I have no idea if you're currently recording right now because I see things on the screen. So I'm going to repeat again. I'm on the side of the river here. And you're probably recording here. What I would want after that is a transcription, a new composition, even though we are going to call that differently in the future. And I would want a picture also of that new composition. We will try to create a new composition. I don't know if you are going to be able to understand all that, but right now I think you are recording. So, Jerry is working on deploying and reviewing a PR that hopefully we will also bring in here. It's going to give us the capability of sharing and synchronizing.
